target.title: fix(handoff): skip orchestrator framing for solo agents without subagents
target.body:
Fixes #102628

## What Problem This Solves

`buildHierarchyReinforcementMessage` unconditionally claimed "You are the new LEADER (Orchestrator)" and showed "ACTIVE SUBORDINATE UNITS: None active." even when the agent had no subagents. This reliably confused models (observed on Claude Opus 4.7) into inventing subordinates or fabricating orchestrator context after quota-suspension/failover recovery.

## Why This Change Was Made

When `activeSubagents` is empty, the message now simply tells the model to review current state and continue instead of presenting orchestrator/subordinate framing that has no referent.

## Evidence
- `git diff --check` clean
- Single file change: `src/auto-reply/handoff-summarizer.ts` (15 insertions, 9 deletions)
